requirements: All pose names must map to each player's roster.json action inventory.
No pose may alter locked face, skin tone, hair/facial-hair reference, jersey number, camera scale, or foot anchor.
Catch/interception poses must preserve ball ownership continuity into run/return loops.
Contact poses must avoid impossible limb intersections and preserve readable silhouettes at Gamecast scale.
Signature names are allowed only when verified or explicitly recognized by project requirements.
